name: Leonel Kaito
source: He become Thief when he was 12, and become student of Antique Ivy this year. However, don't like studying, always sleep during class and ditch class. During night, go to his classmate's room and steal money. He had a crush on Anyo since he was young, but she kept rejecting the propose.
